item.text: I’ll inspect the parallel walker implementation and existing tests, then patch panic handling, add regression coverage, and run the focused test suite under a timeout.

The deadlock comes from worker panics bypassing the worker shutdown protocol: a panicking thread never decrements the active count, so peers can wait forever. I’ll make worker and visitor-builder panics observable, signal all workers to stop, and rethrow the original panic after joining.
